Available Summer 2023 · Furnished · Student Property · Prime Jesmond

Acorn properties are delighted to offer this perfectly located student property, this two bedroom flat situated on Cavendish Place Jesmond. The property briefly comprises, living room, kitchen, two double bedrooms, one shared bathroom. The property also benefits from double glazing, gas central heating and a yard to the rear, with a parking area. Call Acorn Properties to arrange your viewing today!
